text:
Mara - Growth Marketing: Quick kickoff for RefApp Lite launch — goal: OSS reference app + bite-sized tutorial series. Need deliverables: launch post, short benchmark narrative for marketing, webinar, gated landing + lead routing, and 6 social variants. Who takes what?
Josh - DevRel: I can own tutorial content and the demo video. I'll also run a micro-benchmark for three profiles (local, hosted, quantized dedicated). Want results framed for devs, not a vendor showdown.
Samir - Content: I'll draft the blog and social threads. Tone: pragmatic, engineer-first. Plan two post hooks: "Get started locally" and "Optimize for cost & latency".
Emily - Design: I'll do hero layout + 2 screenshots + a 10s demo GIF. Need final copy Thu noon to ship assets. Any special UI needed?
Lee - GrowthOps: Suggest webinar Wed Jun 3 11am PT. Landing: gated form (email + role). Once registered, webhook -> HubSpot and tag with use-case. Routing rule: >200 emp -> AE queue, else nurture.
Mara - Growth Marketing: Good. Benchmark blurbs: 2 lines max. Josh, can you produce median/p95 latency and a simple per-1k-token cost delta for the three profiles? Keep numbers rounded.
Josh - DevRel: Yep. Quick provisional numbers: local dev median 90ms, p95 320ms; hosted median 120ms, p95 420ms; quantized dedicated cost ~3x cheaper per-token vs hosted baseline. I'll finalize after full runs.
Samir - Content: Draft social idea (X thread):
1/ Introducing RefApp Lite  lightweight OSS reference app for local dev -> cloud. Try it, tune perf, contribute. Webinar Jun 3. https://redwood.ai/refapp-lite
2/ Quick benchmarks + link to the reproducible harness.
Keep each tweet short + link to hands-on guide.
Emily - Design: For the benchmark visual I want a small bar chart + annotated callouts. I'll export svg/png.
Zoe - Legal: Heads-up on benchmark claims: please prefix with "Measured on our harness; results may vary". No absolute "we guarantee" language.
Samir - Content: We'll add a test-setup section and link to the bench repo to satisfy that.
Mara - Growth Marketing: CTA order: Try locally (guide), Watch webinar (live demo), Star & contribute. Also split social by persona: devs vs platform teams.
Lee - GrowthOps: Lead fields on form: name, email, company, size, role, use-case, interested-in (dev/test/prod). Zapier -> HubSpot. Also set property "refapp_lite" and "requested_demo" if box checked.
deploy-bot: Release artifact published: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/refapp-lite/v1.0.0/refapp-lite.tar.gz
Josh - DevRel: I'll PR demo + bench scripts to the repo by Mon EOD. Snippet example to include in blog:
```
python -m bench --model small --seq 128 --quantize
```
Samir - Content: Blog outline: TL;DR, quickstart (3 steps), benchmark highlights (callouts + link to harness), tutorial links, contribution guide, webinar CTA. I'll share first draft Tue.
Emily - Design: I'll post initial hero + assets in #design-review and tag you all.
Mara - Growth Marketing: Owners recap: Josh (tutorial + bench), Samir (blog + socials), Emily (assets), Lee (webinar + routing). Publish target: Jun 3 AM blog + webinar same day.
Josh - DevRel: I'll also write 2 mini customer scenarios (edge dev, internal infra) for blog.
Samir - Content: I'll prepare two CTA variants for nurture flows and email templates for registrants.
Zoe - Legal: I'll review copy Fri AM. Keep benchmarks qualified.
Lee - GrowthOps: I'll make the landing page and ensure Zoom + recording auto-post to CDN. Also add calendar invite once registrants >50.
Mara - Growth Marketing: Perfect. Final ask: please keep all assets in the launch folder: /marketing/campaigns/refapp-lite/ and PR any changes. I'll post checklist and timeline tomorrow. :rocket:
